title: Export button stays disabled after choosing a date range
author: Priya Shah
body: The export button stays disabled after I choose a valid date range. Refreshing the page fixes it temporarily.

comments.author: Priya Shah
comments.text: I can reproduce this in Chrome 129 on macOS. The date picker shows the correct range, but the action never enables.

replies.author: Maya Chen
replies.text: Thanks for the clear steps. We found a stale state update and are preparing a fix.

replies.author: Priya Shah
replies.text: That matches what I am seeing. Thank you!

comments.author: Jordan Lee
comments.text: Same issue here. Adding an attachment so you can see the disabled button.

comments.author: Maya Chen
comments.text: We have a fix in review. I will update this thread once the release is available.
